name: Arianeplast
summary: French filament extruder in Sarrebourg (Moselle) producing 'fabriqué en France' filament from NatureWorks Ingeo resins: PLA+ on 1 kg and 8 kg spools in a wide colour range, plus skin-tone, glow, silk, carbon and bamboo PLA, PCTG, Ingeo 3D450 support, ASA, ABS and PETG. Also sells pellets and dyes and takes custom/bulk orders.

product_lines.name: PLA+
product_lines.notes: 1 kg and 8 kg spools; translucent, metallic and pearl colours; on Ingeo 4043D. EUR 23.19 sale / 28.98 list per 1 kg.

product_lines.name: Ingeo 3D450 support
product_lines.notes: NatureWorks Ingeo 3D450 support grade; removal method not confirmed in the notes, so neither pva nor support-breakaway is asserted.

additional_notes: In-house extrusion in Moselle workshops. NatureWorks (Ingeo 4043D, 3D450) is a raw-resin supplier, not a white-label relationship, so oem_relationships is empty. Listed in 3Dnatives' roundup of French filament manufacturers.

provenance.conflicts: Founding year differs: 2015 on the company's own site vs 2018 in 3Dnatives. Formal legal entity not stated.
